entities.name: Yavimaya
entities.description: A heavily forested island in the Terisian Isles that grew into a single sapient mind after the Ice Age.

entities.name: Terisian Isles
entities.description: Archipelago containing Yavimaya.

entities.name: Urborg
entities.description: Place to which part of Yavimaya was relocated.

entities.name: Multani
entities.description: Maro-Sorcerer and domain-holder of Yavimaya, its emissary and voice; later awakened by rage and spurred Yavimaya to frantic action.

entities.name: Rofellos
entities.description: Llanowar elf sent to Yavimaya to foster relations and build defenses; exchanged places with Multani as voice of Yavimaya.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Planeswalker who journeyed to Yavimaya seeking aid against the Phyrexians and was taken captive by Multani.

entities.name: Muldrotha
entities.description: Multani's child, born in Yavimaya's offshoot on Urborg; wild, dark, unpredictable and relentless.

entities.name: Meria
entities.description: Leader of the Yavimayan elves who joined the Coalition against the Second Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Jeska
entities.description: Under Leshrac's influence, used Radha to seal the Yavimayan rift.

entities.name: Radha
entities.description: Warrior used by Jeska to seal the rift, who lost her potential to become a planeswalker.

entities.name: Leshrac
entities.description: Influenced Jeska to seal the rift.

entities.name: Yavimayan elves
entities.description: Elves in symbiosis with the forest, now Kavu riders.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Invaders against whom Yavimaya prepared defenses.

entities.name: The Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The great Phyrexian invasion of Dominaria.

entities.name: The Sylex Blast
entities.description: Urza's blast that resulted in Yavimaya's rift.

entities.name: Juniper Order
entities.description: Druids allowed into Yavimaya who formed a lasting pact with the forest.

entities.name: The Weatherseed
entities.description: Seed of the Heart of Yavimaya that Urza transformed into the hull of the Skyship Weatherlight.

entities.name: Skyship Weatherlight
entities.description: Ship whose hull Urza made from the Weatherseed.

entities.name: Verdeloth
entities.description: A titanic treefolk of Yavimaya.

entities.name: Argoth
entities.description: Island Urza decimated.

entities.name: Civimore
entities.description: The elven kingdom in the boughs of Yavimaya.

entities.name: New Argive
entities.description: Island east of Yavimaya, connected by magnigoth mangals.

events.summary: Rofellos arrives in Yavimaya to build its defenses and exchanges places with Multani as voice of the forest, freeing Multani to travel.
events.quote: he exchanged places with Multani as voice of Yavimaya, allowing Multani to go abroad in the world.

events.summary: Urza journeys to Yavimaya to enlist aid against the Phyrexians and is taken captive by Multani; his consciousness merges with the forest's for a time.
events.quote: Urza was then taken captive by the forest's emissary, Multani.

events.summary: During the Phyrexian Invasion, Multani transplants part of Yavimaya to Urborg's edge for the last great battle.
events.quote: Multani transplanted part of Yavimaya to Urborg 's edge

events.summary: Under Leshrac's influence, Jeska uses Radha to seal the rift, costing Radha her potential to become a planeswalker.
events.quote: Under the influence of Leshrac , Jeska used Radha to seal the rift, causing the warrior to lose her potential to become a planeswalker.

events.summary: Sixty years after the Mending, Multani's mind awakens in rage and Muldrotha is born on Urborg.
events.quote: his child Muldrotha was born into Yavimaya's offshoot on Urborg

events.summary: Cast out by Multani's raging spirit, the Yavimayan elves live as exiles.
events.quote: Cast out by the raging spirit of Multani, Yavimayan elves had to live as exiles on the outskirts of their former home.

events.summary: Multani calms and the elves return to Yavimaya.
events.quote: Now that Multani has calmed, the elves are free to return to Yavimaya.

relations.note: Transformed the Weatherseed into the hull
relations.quote: Urza transformed it to form the hull of the Skyship Weatherlight .
Yavimaya is a heavily forested island in the archipelago of the Terisian Isles .
